sources.title: ITU-R M.2012-7: LTE-Advanced radio-interface specification
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: LTE-Advanced 載波聚合：瓶頸與不等頻段
related.titleEn: LTE-Advanced carrier aggregation: unequal carriers and bottlenecks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 400 byte 與 960 byte，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 400 byte and 960 byte, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋60 Mbit/s與50 Mbit/s，建立ca_capacity.csv、各段瓶頸圖、載波啟用證據，並完成以下驗收：55 Mbit/s需求僅第一配置可行；報告回程限制而非誤稱空中介面只有60能力。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 60 Mbit/s and 50 Mbit/s; create ca_capacity.csv, bottleneck diagram and carrier-activation evidence; apply this acceptance decision: Only the first configuration meets55 Mbit/s; report a backhaul limit rather than declaring a60 Mbit/s radio limit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 連續媒體可由緩衝吸收有限中斷；所需緩衝至少為到達速率乘服務中斷，但不能掩蓋無限延遲。 展開基準式 64000*0.05/8；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：依20 ms媒體封包畫離散到達線；連續模型須向上取整到完整封包容量。 將兩條推導一起存入 handover_timeline.csv、緩衝占用曲線、雙路徑時間戳。
從原理 聚合的有效率是各載波有效率之和，再受終端或回程瓶頸限制；不可只加頻寬宣稱同倍率增益。 展開基準式 min(40+30,60)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：畫每載波與回程三段吞吐，總流量不得超過任一共享瓶頸；核對同一時間窗。 將兩條推導一起存入 ca_capacity.csv、各段瓶頸圖、載波啟用證據。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from A buffer can absorb bounded media interruption; required storage is arrival rate times interruption, without eliminating latency., expand baseline expression 64000*0.05/8; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Draw arrivals of20 ms media packets; round the continuous estimate up to whole packet storage. Save both derivations with handover_timeline.csv, buffer occupancy and old/new-path timestamps.

Starting from Aggregate goodput sums carrier goodput then meets UE/backhaul bottlenecks; adding bandwidth alone does not establish proportional speedup., expand baseline expression min(40+30,60); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Draw the two carriers and shared backhaul; total flow cannot exceed a shared bottleneck and all rates need one time window. Save both derivations with ca_capacity.csv, bottleneck diagram and carrier-activation evidence.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 5G NR 上行功率控制：飽和與頻寬分配
related.titleEn: 5G NR uplink power control: saturation and bandwidth allocation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 400 byte 與 960 byte，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 400 byte and 960 byte, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋10 dBm與23 dBm，建立nr_power.csv、飽和前後數值、功率餘裕，並完成以下驗收：第二配置不得按26 dBm做鏈路預算；可減少M或降需求再重算，不提供實際發射設定。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 10 dBm and 23 dBm; create nr_power.csv, clipped/unclipped values and power headroom; apply this acceptance decision: Do not budget the second case at26 dBm; reduceM or demand and recalculate offline rather than changing real transmit settings.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 連續媒體可由緩衝吸收有限中斷；所需緩衝至少為到達速率乘服務中斷，但不能掩蓋無限延遲。 展開基準式 64000*0.05/8；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：依20 ms媒體封包畫離散到達線；連續模型須向上取整到完整封包容量。 將兩條推導一起存入 handover_timeline.csv、緩衝占用曲線、雙路徑時間戳。

從原理 簡化P=min(Pmax,P0+alpha*PL+10log10M)，區分總功率與每資源功率；省略的閉環補償不可默認為已驗證。 展開基準式 min(23,-80+0.8*100+10*log10(10))；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先算未截限10與26 dBm，再套上23上限；用功率餘裕欄記第二組缺3 dB。 將兩條推導一起存入 nr_power.csv、飽和前後數值、功率餘裕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from A buffer can absorb bounded media interruption; required storage is arrival rate times interruption, without eliminating latency., expand baseline expression 64000*0.05/8; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Draw arrivals of20 ms media packets; round the continuous estimate up to whole packet storage. Save both derivations with handover_timeline.csv, buffer occupancy and old/new-path timestamps.

Starting from Use simplified P=min(Pmax,P0+alpha*PL+10log10M), distinguishing total and per-resource power; omitted closed-loop terms remain unverified., expand baseline expression min(23,-80+0.8*100+10*log10(10)); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Calculate unclipped10/26 dBm before imposing23; mark the second case as3 dB short in the power-headroom column. Save both derivations with nr_power.csv, clipped/unclipped values and power headroom.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
